versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Community Marketing skill.

- Provides practical strategies for building, launching, and growing online communities across major platforms (Discord, Slack, forums, etc.).
- Includes playbooks tailored to key goals: community launch, member growth, engagement, support deflection, and ambassador programs.
- Offers platform comparison guidance and actionable community health metrics.
- Defines clear output formats: strategy docs, channel architecture, member journeys, ritual calendars, ambassador briefs, and health audits.
- Emphasizes community design around shared identity and member-first value.
